## GET `/api/2.29/lifecycle-rules`

**Tier:** T0  

Returns a list of lifecycle rules. If `names` is specified, list the individual rules. If `ids` is specified, `bucket_names` or `bucket_ids` is also required. If `bucket_names` or `bucket_ids` are specified without `ids`, list all the rules for the bucket.

## POST `/api/2.29/lifecycle-rules`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a lifecycle rule. `bucket` and `keep_previous_version_for` are required. If `rule_id` is not specified, it will be automatically generated in the format "fbRuleIdX".

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `confirm_date` | query | boolean |  | If set to `true`, then confirm the date of `keep_current_version_until` is correct. |
| `context_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the context specified. If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If not… |

**Request body** (required): `LifecycleRulePost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `abort_incomplete_multipart_uploads_after` | integer (int64) | The duration of time in milliseconds after which incomplete multipart uploads are aborted. This value must be a multiple of 86400000 to represent a whole number of days. |
| `keep_current_version_for` | integer (int64) | The time in milliseconds after which current versions are marked expired. This value must be a multiple of 86400000 to represent a whole number of days. |
| `keep_current_version_until` | integer (int64) | The time since epoch in milliseconds after which current versions are marked expired. This value must be a valid date accurate to the day. |
| `keep_previous_version_for` | integer (int64) | The time in milliseconds after which previous versions are marked expired. This value must be a multiple of 86400000 to represent a whole number of days. |
| `prefix` | string | The object key prefix identifying one or more objects in the bucket. The maximum length is 1024 characters. |
| `bucket` | `_referenceWritable` | The bucket that this lifecycle rule targets. |
| `rule_id` | string | The identifier for the rule that is unique to the bucket that it applies to. The maximum length is 255 characters. If not specified, defaults to a generated ID unique to the bucket in the format… |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `LifecycleRuleResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.29/lifecycle-rules`

**Tier:** T3
